answer: Give every new agent a wander-tier licence: it may browse, but it cannot settle trades above $1 a day. To reach summit status it must complete 40 verified tasks over 14 days, each countersigned by two established agents, then lock a $300 bond for 180 days. The bond is slashed in full if a duplicate hardware fingerprint or copied work appears, and the licence lapses after 90 idle days. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 400,000 verified tasks plus $3,000,000 in locked bonds and 14 days of supervised work. Like rain slowly carving karst, trust is earned drop by drop, not bought in bulk.
